work_items.title: Native Rust workspace and reproducible builds
work_items.how: Pinned Rust 1.100.0 and locked Cargo graphs. The native runtime uses only the standard library, and its library/binary forbid unsafe code. Development and fuzz dependencies are separate from runtime code.
work_items.verification: Linux debug/release builds and Clippy passed locally and in PR #7.
work_items.limitations: This qualifies the lab toolchain only; crypto, storage and other runtime libraries remain undecided.

work_items.title: Bounded BER / LDAP decoder
work_items.how: Implemented checked definite BER lengths and integer/tag validation without recursion. Frames are capped at 16 KiB, with attribute count/name and DN bounds applied before accepting requests.
work_items.verification: Negative tests cover truncation, malformed lengths/IDs/tags, unsupported controls and attribute limits; generated inputs exercise bounded behavior.
work_items.limitations: Only the declared LDAP subset is decoded; this is not full LDAP or AD conformance.

work_items.title: Read-only RootDSE queries
work_items.how: Implemented empty-DN base searches for objectClass presence. Explicit attribute projection, *, +, 1.1 and typesOnly select static public metadata. No AD capability OIDs or naming contexts are advertised.
work_items.verification: The independent ldap3 client reads supportedLDAPVersion and vendor metadata from the running binary.
work_items.limitations: There are no users, groups, schema, directory state or general searches.

work_items.title: Credential rejection and safe diagnostics
work_items.how: Only anonymous access to public lab metadata succeeds. Credential/SASL binds fail. Parsed request/debug state retains no bind DN or password, and service diagnostics use static messages.
work_items.verification: Tests verify credential rejection, no credential echo in debug/response/stdout/stderr, and unsupported search failures.
work_items.limitations: This is a safeguard, not authentication or password management. There is no TLS; never send real credentials.

work_items.title: TCP framing and session budgets
work_items.how: Implemented fragmented/coalesced frame reads and a loopback-only, single-active-connection listener. Every read/write uses the remaining five-second total deadline; sessions stop after 32 requests.
work_items.verification: Socket tests cover idle deadlines, framing, public-interface refusal and request limits. A malformed peer does not kill the process.
work_items.limitations: The sequential listener is a lab design, not a production availability or throughput claim.

work_items.title: Independent client and packaged-binary checks
work_items.how: A separate Python ldap3 client launches the Rust process on an ephemeral loopback port. CI tests the release binary, then extracts the internal archive and tests that executable again.
work_items.verification: Positive RootDSE, credential denial, scope denial, malformed-peer recovery and extracted-binary checks passed.
work_items.limitations: This is Linux client evidence, not Windows domain join or a deployment qualification.

work_items.title: Property tests and core coverage gate
work_items.how: Added native negative/integration/property tests and instrumented coverage. The actual process is exercised in addition to direct parser tests; the core gate requires at least 90% lines.
work_items.verification: 21 Rust integration/property tests passed. Local measured core line coverage exceeded 90%; Python tooling had 34 passing tests and 98% combined coverage.
work_items.limitations: Core line coverage excludes test/CLI dispatch files. Percentages do not measure coverage of future AD functionality.

work_items.title: Sanitizer fuzz smoke
work_items.how: Added a separate locked libFuzzer target for decode/respond and frame reading, seeded only with synthetic wire data. The PR budget caps iterations, time, input size and RSS.
work_items.verification: 20,000 local address-sanitizer fuzz runs completed without a crash and without changing the lockfiles. Hosted PR #7 fuzz also passed.
work_items.limitations: A bounded fuzz run is not proof that no vulnerability exists. Longer schedules apply after the workflow reaches main.

work_items.title: Native dependency, license and SBOM checks
work_items.how: Cargo deny checks advisories, licenses, sources and dependency bans for core and fuzz graphs, including development/build dependencies. Checksum-pinned Syft catalogs Cargo.lock into a CycloneDX inventory.
work_items.verification: Both dependency audits passed; the generated source inventory was checked for proptest and libfuzzer-sys.
work_items.limitations: The SBOM includes test/fuzz dependencies; it is not a runtime-only or complete OS/stdlib inventory. The project license is still undecided.

work_items.title: Required native and repository CI gates
work_items.how: Added native build/coverage, supply-chain and sanitizer-fuzz jobs behind a reusable fail-closed aggregate. New source scopes must be explicitly registered with checks. Actions/tools/dependencies are pinned or hash-locked.
work_items.verification: All 11 checks in the main-branch CI run passed at merge commit 3a69a6b, following PR #7.
work_items.limitations: Checks run, but GitHub merge protection is not enforced on the current private-repository plan. Passing CI does not establish AD compatibility or production readiness.

work_items.title: Complete phase specifications and traceability
work_items.how: Created 18 phase designs with 180 phase requirements referencing all 130 global capability IDs. CI checks missing phases, unknown/duplicate IDs, empty acceptance and unassigned capabilities.
work_items.verification: The baseline validator and its negative regression cases pass.
work_items.limitations: A consistent document is not passing product evidence; no phase has been accepted.

work_items.title: Threat model and open decision register
work_items.how: Documented component authority, identity/state/replication invariants, attack paths and capacity assumptions. Unresolved choices have owner roles and explicit blocking points.
work_items.verification: Reviewed for internal consistency and linked into phase designs.
work_items.limitations: Named accountable owners, independent assessment, Windows lab, final storage/key choices and measured capacity remain outstanding.

work_items.title: Tested source and lab archive packaging
work_items.how: Source packaging archives the tested commit with deterministic compression and checksum verification. The lab archive is checked after extraction; source release remains license-gated and creates drafts only.
work_items.verification: Committed-source exclusion, unsafe-tag/Git-failure tests and internal archive smoke checks passed.
work_items.limitations: No production installer, signed native product release, directory upgrade or recovery deployment exists.

work_items.title: Phase dashboard and portable engineering report
work_items.how: Built a typed standalone dashboard from canonical phase/feature documents and reviewed progress facts, with phase/substep navigation, source evidence, issues and export.
work_items.verification: PR #11 implementation includes model/security tests and desktop/mobile browser validation.
work_items.limitations: This is engineering reporting, not the product directory administration UI. It does not implement P01-08 or accept a phase.

work_items.title: Permanent private GitHub dashboard publication
work_items.how: Rendered the validated model into a README-only automation branch using structured GitHub API requests, privacy checks, idempotence and fast-forward publication.
work_items.verification: The report branch was created and read back; idempotent refresh and stale-main handling were exercised.
work_items.limitations: The original publication only followed main and omitted open-PR proposals; that limitation is addressed by the current development PR.

work_items.title: Compact interactive interface and verified static-hosting workflow
work_items.how: Replaced duplicate navigation with compact phase cards and a phase picker; made work/problems expandable. Added a separate Pages workflow consuming only an immutable successful-main HTML artifact.
work_items.verification: PR #15 CI passed its 22 browser checks and hosting-source validation tests. The later merged main audit failure is recorded independently.
work_items.limitations: A configured workflow is not a live site. Pages is not enabled and no in-chat preview route was established.

work_items.title: Bounded LDAP RootDSE filter discovery
work_items.how: Evaluates presence, objectClass descriptor/OID equality and AND/OR/NOT against the fixed public RootDSE. Uses True/False/Undefined semantics, visits every branch, enforces depth 8 / 64 nodes / 256 assertion bytes and never retains assertion bytes.
work_items.verification: Local validation: 28 Rust tests, generated boolean/identifier properties, independent ldap3 positive/empty/unsupported checks, 94.49% core line coverage (filter module 100%) and 20,000 sanitizer-fuzz iterations without a crash.
work_items.limitations: Lab-only synthetic/public data. Other matching rules, general directory/schema queries, DNS, credentials, TLS and Windows domain interoperability remain unimplemented.

work_items.title: Open-PR-aware private progress reporting
work_items.how: Reads open PR descriptions/files/CI state and bounded progress JSON as data. Shows new/changed work and problem records separately from main totals, links PR-head evidence to affected substeps and preserves per-record historical revisions.
work_items.verification: Local validation: 74 Python tests with 98% combined tooling coverage. GitHub Markdown rendering verified that a hostile PR description remained inert and preserved all phase disclosures.
work_items.limitations: Automatic PR refresh activates after merge. Fork structured facts are omitted; metadata has explicit listing limits. Private overlays never enter public HTML artifacts.

work_items.title: Remove unpatched vulnerable tooling dependency path
work_items.how: Removed TypeScript-ESLint and its picomatch path. Retained supported ESLint 10 / TypeScript 6, strict compiler checks and explicit-any AST checks; runs DOM/eval rules on compiler-erased JavaScript without bundling, minification or execution.
work_items.verification: Locked clean install; npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities. Six build/lint tests include typed HTML sinks, eval, explicit-any declarations/casts and safe text rendering; strict typecheck and lint pass.
work_items.limitations: This replaces recommended TypeScript style rules with documented compiler/security policies; it does not claim rule-for-rule style equivalence. PR #16 is merged; main run 44153995669 passed all 12 jobs.

work_items.title: Scope-based phase sizes and explicit owner acceptance reviews
work_items.how: Removed the enforced ten-item sequential quota, retaining unique phase-owned IDs, nonempty requirements/evidence and feature traceability. Renamed broad dashboard substeps to requirements. Documented concrete owner review questions and separate requirement/phase acceptance. Existing scope and stable IDs are preserved.
work_items.verification: 78 Python tests pass with 98% tooling coverage. Strict types, lint, documentation checks, six build/security-lint tests and 24 desktop/mobile browser tests pass. Synthetic 3/13-item phases exercise rendering, counts and expand-all; model/design fixtures allow unequal counts and noncontiguous IDs.
work_items.limitations: The current baseline still contains 180 requirements. Changing task counts does not estimate effort or accept work. Two current-component acceptance questions have been submitted to the owner; no affirmative answers have been recorded. Full AD functionality and phase acceptance remain outstanding.

problems.title: GitHub API initially blocked by egress policy
problems.detail: Git reads/pushes worked while api.github.com was excluded, so draft PR creation returned Forbidden. The CLI auth error alone did not establish missing credentials.
problems.resolution: The owner opened Internet/API access; the PR retry succeeded without asking for a raw token.
problems.next_action: Keep API connectivity distinct from Git and credential readiness.
problems.provenance: Recorded development-session incident; no public issue was created.

problems.title: Mandatory merge protection unavailable on current GitHub plan
problems.detail: GitHub rejected ruleset access for this private repository with HTTP 403 and requested a supported plan or public visibility. Passing CI is not enforced merge protection.
problems.next_action: Owner chooses a supported plan/visibility and configures required checks/reviews. No paid-plan or visibility change has been made.
problems.provenance: GitHub API observation recorded during pipeline setup; verify again before production release.

problems.title: Project license and contributor policy not selected
problems.detail: No project LICENSE is selected. Native crates remain unpublished and source-prerelease creation is blocked by the license gate.
problems.next_action: Project owner resolves D-01 before public distribution and external contribution policy acceptance.
problems.provenance: Current repository decision register; third-party development license policy does not choose the project license.

problems.title: Licensed isolated Windows reference lab is missing
problems.detail: Independent Linux LDAP-client evidence exists, but there is no recorded real Windows join/login/GPO conformance result or qualified reference image matrix.
problems.next_action: Provide reproducible isolated Windows/reference hosts and exact supported builds before accepting Windows behavior.
problems.provenance: Explicitly outstanding; no Windows test is marked passed.

problems.title: Persistent identity, storage and replication decisions remain open
problems.detail: The lab has no persistent state. SID/GUID/schema/ACL, transaction/journal format, key custody and compatible replication metadata require reviewed designs and failure tests.
problems.next_action: Resolve D-04/D-05/D-06 before valuable credential-bearing writes or fixed recovery formats.
problems.provenance: Design blocker, not an implemented storage defect.

problems.title: Proposed SBOM generator had a yanked locked dependency
problems.detail: The proposed cargo-cyclonedx installation reported a yanked transitive XML dependency. That generator was not used for accepted SBOM output.
problems.resolution: Removed the unused tool and used checksum-pinned Syft 1.57.2 for Cargo.lock source inventory. Native project/fuzz dependency graphs are audited separately.
problems.next_action: Review SBOM tool pins and upstream advisories regularly.
problems.provenance: Recorded development-session tool-selection correction; no checksum or advisory bypass was introduced.

problems.title: Fuzzer license and path dependency failed the initial audit
problems.detail: libfuzzer-sys requires NCSA alongside its MIT/Apache choice; the initial allowlist lacked it. The local path dependency also lacked an exact version constraint.
problems.resolution: Recorded the development-harness license obligation, enabled development/build license checks and pinned the local path version. Both graphs now pass.
problems.next_action: Retain upstream notices; do not confuse this development policy with project-license approval.
problems.provenance: Initial cargo-deny findings and subsequent passing audits.

problems.title: SBOM cataloger selection used the wrong CLI operation
problems.detail: The initial Syft selector treated a cataloger name as a tag and produced no valid report.
problems.resolution: Switched to the explicit default-cataloger override and checked that CycloneDX output contains both core-development and fuzz packages.
problems.next_action: Validate report contents as well as command success when changing catalog/tool versions.
problems.provenance: Recorded local validation failure and correction; the failed output was not counted as evidence.

problems.title: Design checker needed precise empty-acceptance handling
problems.detail: A regression test found that an empty acceptance cell was reported as a missing row instead of a specific empty-cell error.
problems.resolution: Adjusted the row parser and added explicit empty-cell validation. The negative test and complete baseline now pass.
problems.next_action: Keep negative cases when modifying the document schema.
problems.provenance: Recorded implementation-test failure; no product conformance was affected.

problems.title: Dashboard access and Pages activation remain unavailable
problems.detail: The app ran inside the cloud workspace, but no user-accessible preview route was established. GitHub returned HTTP 403 for Pages activation; the repository still reports Pages disabled.
problems.next_action: Keep progress available on the private GitHub report; a future hosting change needs an actually verified accessible URL.
problems.provenance: Recorded development-session evidence and repository/CI observations; no separate public issue was created.

problems.title: Preserve Undefined while adding boolean LDAP filters
problems.detail: A binary match/nonmatch model would incorrectly turn an unrecognized attribute into a match when negated. Unsupported matching also must not be hidden by a true OR branch.
problems.resolution: Implemented explicit Undefined/Unsupported outcomes, full branch validation and exact resource limits with negative/property/client tests.
problems.next_action: Review matching rules before any general directory/schema implementation.
problems.provenance: Recorded development-session evidence and repository/CI observations; no separate public issue was created.

problems.title: Progress facts and the GitHub report omitted recent PR contents
problems.detail: Main progress still referenced the initial native snapshot after dashboard PRs merged; pending implementation and its explanations were absent until manual updates.
problems.resolution: Backfilled merged dashboard work and added bounded private PR overlays with per-record revisions, pending labels and current main CI health.
problems.next_action: Update progress facts in every development PR; automatic PR import activates after this change is merged.
problems.provenance: Recorded development-session evidence and repository/CI observations; no separate public issue was created.

problems.title: Main CI rejected newly vulnerable picomatch tooling graph
problems.detail: Main run 44142657828 failed npm audit for GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf. The advisory affects picomatch through 4.0.7 and no patched version was published when checked.
problems.resolution: PR #16 removed the vulnerable dependency path while retaining supported compiler/ESLint versions and tested DOM/eval/explicit-any checks. Merged main run 44153995669 passed all 12 jobs, including dependency audit.
problems.next_action: Keep all-severity audit enforcement and regression coverage on future tooling updates.
problems.provenance: Recorded development-session evidence and repository/CI observations; no separate public issue was created.

problems.title: Fixed requirement quotas and ambiguous substep acceptance labels
problems.detail: The design validator forced exactly ten sequential requirements per phase, while the report called those broad contracts substeps. Zero recorded acceptances made implemented increments hard to distinguish from owner-reviewed scope.
problems.resolution: Removed the fixed quota, clarified requirement/increment labels, and documented asking the owner scoped evidence-based questions before recording acceptance. Regression tests cover unequal phase sizes; statuses are unchanged while answers are pending.
problems.next_action: Record explicit owner answers with reviewer/date/evidence. Decompose future work according to scope and dependencies while preserving requirement coverage.
problems.provenance: Project owner requested acceptance questions and said substep counts need not be linear; no separate GitHub issue was created.

focus_summary: The read-only RootDSE lab is implemented. The development PR adds bounded LDAP boolean/objectClass filters and PR-aware progress reporting; durable identities, DNS, authentication and domain services remain future work.
